internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Elevated Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:28 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the cart service. The error rate reached 1.0 with elevated p95 latency of 0.12 seconds, indicating a critical issue originating from the cart service. Secondary impacts were observed in the frontend and checkout services with elevated error rates and latencies but were less severe.

Diagnosis confirmed the cart service as the primary source of errors. A mitigation action was proposed and approved to disable the 'cartFailure' flag at 11:48 UTC. This action was executed promptly, resulting in a verified recovery with error rates returning to normal levels.

The incident was resolved shortly after the mitigation action was applied. Further analysis and lessons learned are documented below.

external.title: Some customers experienced issues with adding items to cart
external.body: Between 11:28 and 11:48 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues when adding items to their shopping cart, which may have affected their ability to complete purchases. The issue was identified and resolved by 11:48 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

output.summary: High error rate in cart service caused customer impact; resolved by disabling a faulty feature flag.
output.impact: Customers experienced issues adding items to their shopping cart, potentially affecting purchase completion during the incident window.
output.root_cause: A critical error injection in the cart service caused elevated error rates and latency, traced to a faulty feature flag 'cartFailure'. Disabling this flag resolved the issue.
output.resolution: The 'cartFailure' feature flag was disabled after approval, which immediately restored normal service operation and error rates.

lessons.lesson: Implement stricter validation and monitoring for feature flags to prevent critical error injections from faulty flags.
lessons.applies_when: A feature flag causes elevated error rates in the cart service.

lessons.lesson: Ensure rapid multi-approver workflows are in place for critical mitigation actions to minimize downtime.
lessons.applies_when: The cart service experiences a critical error rate requiring immediate mitigation.

action_items: Review and improve feature flag validation processes.
Enhance alerting and escalation procedures for critical service errors.
Conduct training on rapid incident response and approval workflows.
